advisories.text: The seven new reader cases do not directly inject a foreign-workspace parent or a database-read exception. EF filter/source inspection plus existing MemoryIsolationTests support the current checkpoint, but add reader-specific workspace/outage negative controls before claiming complete policy integration.

GetExactAsync accepts a caller-provided digest; it does not authenticate the active manifest, approved source/type, or binding. That boundary is explicitly outside this reader and must be proven in live MCP integration before slice A exit.

Historical-version case seeds v1/v2 and reads v1; it does not mutate then read. Existing MemoryVersionTests covers append history separately. The reader digest check detects changed historical bytes rather than preventing a privileged database rewrite.
The earlier full McpServer suite was stopped after hanging; current run is focused 7 plus existing isolation 2. Full suite green and next hostile gate remain open before slice A completion.
